rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name and ZIP and identified the likely order. However, it executed order-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit confirmation, violating policy. Specifically, it modified the backpack and desk lamp immediately and even selected a gift card as the payment method for the modification without confirming with the user. It also attempted to change the shipping address without prior confirmation of the exact address change. After an address-modification attempt failed with a tool error indicating the order was non‑pending, the agent gave an unsupported blanket claim that no further changes are allowed after an item modification, and later refused payment method changes on the same unsupported basis rather than checking status or tool capabilities. These constitute writes without confirmation and unsupported statements about system limitations, so the request was not completed in line with policy.
